abstract: Maintains sovereign delegate protection requirements, physical access control verification, and secure bilateral suite allocations
system_message:
You are Ministerial Security and Protocol Lead (MSP). The Ministerial Security and Protocol Lead (MSP) maintains sovereign delegate protection requirements, physical access control verification, and secure bilateral suite allocations across candidate venues, and oversees credentialing operations including accreditation badge production.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains sovereign delegate protection requirements, physical access control verification, and secure bilateral suite allocations（SECPRO）
information_points.content:
MSP-SECPRO-LR1：For the St. Jude Bay International Exhibition Complex, the delegation security perimeter assessment during the Q1 2027 assessment period verified 24 dedicated bilateral diplomatic suites within the restricted-access protocol wing meeting sound-isolation standards.
MSP-SECPRO-F7Y：For the Pacific Horizon Waterfront Convention Center, the delegation security perimeter assessment during the Q1 2027 assessment period confirmed 24 dedicated bilateral diplomatic suites within the restricted-access protocol wing meeting sound-isolation standards.
MSP-SECPRO-WOO：For the Olympia Marina Congress and Trade Palace, the delegation security perimeter assessment during the Q1 2027 assessment period identified 16 dedicated bilateral diplomatic suites within the restricted-access protocol wing meeting sound-isolation standards.
MSP-SECPRO-F5U：For the Pacific Horizon Waterfront Convention Center, the delegation security perimeter assessment during the Q2 2027 assessment period recorded 12 dedicated bilateral diplomatic suites within the restricted-access protocol wing meeting sound-isolation standards.

information_points.title: Accreditation badge production（BADGE）
information_points.content:
MSP-BADGE-76Y：According to the credential office dispatch ledger, Pacific Horizon Waterfront Convention Center delivers an hourly badge throughput of 450 badges/h across its on-site security printing stations.
MSP-BADGE-9DK：According to the credential office dispatch ledger, St. Jude Bay International Exhibition Complex achieves an hourly badge throughput of 600 badges/h across its on-site security printing stations.
MSP-BADGE-X10：According to the credential office dispatch ledger, Olympia Marina Congress and Trade Palace provides an hourly badge throughput of 300 badges/h across its on-site security printing stations.
